text:
Ellen: Heads-up from today's console QA sweep: compact toolbar (top-right) has multiple a11y nits. Keyboard users can't tell which control is focused, SR reads icons without context, and the overflow menu is not reachable via arrow keys. Quick notes and mini repro below. a11y-bot: Quick scan: 7 contrast issues (icon-only buttons), 4 missing accessible names, 2 focus-visible failures. See mock: https://internal/reports/a11y/2077778888 (placeholder). Marco: Repro steps? I couldn't repro on Windows+NVDA, might be macOS specific. Ellen: Steps (macOS VoiceOver, Safari): 1) Open Console > Top toolbar (compact mode) 2) Tab to toolbar and cycle controls, then open overflow menu with keyboard Expected: each icon announces name (e.g., "Search, button"), focus ring clearly visible, overflow menu items reachable with Arrow keys and announce role/menuitem Actual: VoiceOver says "button" when landing on first icon; visual focus is thin (1px) and almost invisible on light theme; overflow menu opens but items not reachable with Arrow keys (Tab only), and sometimes focus traps in menu anchor. DOM snippet: ```html
    • <\/ul>
    ``` Priya: A few patterns here: icon buttons need explicit aria-labels (looks like some are missing or not reflected due to i18n keys), SVGs must be aria-hidden if decorative, and focus styles should use `:focus-visible` with a 2px ring and accessible color token. Dev: Overflow menu should be a proper ARIA menu: the trigger has `aria-haspopup=\"menu\" aria-expanded=\"false\"` and the list should be `role=\"menu\"` with items `role=\"menuitem\"`. Keyboard support: Enter/Space to open, ArrowDown/ArrowUp to move between items, Escape to close and return focus to trigger. Avoid using Tab to navigate inside menus. Ellen: Also seeing VoiceOver read the icon label and then read an adjacent tooltip twice when the tooltip is implemented as a live region. Tooltips should be ARIA-described only on focus/hover and use `role=\"tooltip\"` with `aria-hidden` toggling, not an always-live element. a11y-bot: Additional checks: ensure button hit target >= 44x44px for touch, ensure color tokens for focus ring meet 3:1 contrast against both light/dark backgrounds, and validate i18n keys map to user-facing aria-labels in localized builds. Marco: Implementation plan: - Audit toolbar icon buttons for missing aria-labels and add fallback visually-hidden text where labels are dynamic. - Add `aria-hidden=\"true\"` to decorative SVGs and ensure accessible name comes from `aria-label` or inner text. - Implement `:focus-visible` rule: `outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-glow);` and respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. - Convert overflow to ARIA menu pattern, wire Arrow nav, and ensure `aria-expanded` toggles. - Move tooltips out of live regions and use `role=\"tooltip\"` toggled on hover/focus with proper timeout. Priya: Small UX request: for compact mode we might show a visible label on focus (visually-hidden -> visible-on-focus) so keyboard users get an extra cue without impacting layout. Example CSS rule: `.icon-btn:focus .label{clip:auto;opacity:1}`. Keep animations disabled under reduced motion. Dev: I'll draft a tiny PR that: fixes aria-labels, converts overflow to menu role, updates focus styles, and adds an e2e keyboard test exercising open/close and Arrow navigation. Assigning to @Priya for review. Will include before/after VoiceOver notes. Ellen: Thanks! Please also add a regression a11y test that runs axe against the toolbar component in both compact and expanded modes. :sparkles:
